item.title: Ask a friend to prove it
item.summary: In a 1v1 game, tap your friend's photo on Home and choose Prove it, and Murph opens a short, playful case in your game chat asking them for proof.
item.details: You get one per game, and your friend sees it came from you. Murph never rules on it: the post stands unless your friend marks the day as not counting, and then you get your Prove it back. Available in the latest app version.
